desc: The Little Badger is the ultimate packable survival gun. Available in .22lr, .22WMR, 17HMR, 17 WSM this lightweight, ultra-compact, break-open rifle is designed to go anywhere at any time. When the action is opened and the gun folded, it measures a mere 17 overall length and stows neatly in an included pack/ case. An optional handle cleaning kit combination accessory screws into the bottom of the receiver. Compact length and weighing only 2.9lbs, the Little Badger can truly be taken and ready for use just about anywhere!
